data.description: Original Protocol for Phase 3 Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study ENLIGHTEN-2 (J3R-MC-YDAF), Protocol Number J3R-MC-YDAF

Protocol Amendment (a) – nonsubstantial amendment addressing feedback from an internal safety committee. Changes include updates to Exclusion Criteria (Section 5.2), Initiation of new Antihyperglycemic Medications (Section 6.9.1), Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia (Section 6.9.2), and Prohibited Medications (Section 6.9.3) regarding insulin use restrictions. Electronically Signed and Approved by Lilly. Document ID: VV-CLIN-198891.
